sample_unit: interview participants (25 young adult patients and 9 clinicians)
unlisted_practices: Patient-facing AI should elicit the patient's course of care and timing of symptoms
Convey clinician-set criteria for expected versus harmful pain
Proactive follow-up by the AI between visits
Explain reasons when AI answers are revised under user challenge
Hand off from AI to clinicians
Evaluate patient-facing AI over time rather than at single moments

screen.reason: Qualitative empirical study exploring how patients use generative AI chatbots for musculoskeletal pain between visits and interviewing clinicians to understand needs, risks, and guardrail requirements.
